[ii 3] Aššur has given the totality of the four regions to him. From sunrise to sunset there is no king equal to him; he shines as brilliantly as the sun.
[ii 8] This is the (oracle of) well-being placed before Bel-Tarbaṣi and the gods.
(ruling)
[ii 10] Now then, these traitors provoked you, had you banished, and surrounded you; but you opened your mouth (and cried): "Hear me, O Aššur!"
[ii 14] I heard your cry. I issued forth as a fiery glow from the gate of heaven, to hurl down fire and have it devour them.
[ii 18] You were standing in their midst, so I removed them from your presence. I drove them up the mountain and rained (hail)stones and fire of heaven upon then.
[ii 22] I slaughtered your enemies and filled the river with their blood. Let them see (it) and praise me, (knowing) that I am Aššur, lord of the gods.[ii 26]This is the well-being (placed) before the Image. [ii 27]This covenant tablet of Aššur enters the king's presence on a cushion. Fragrant oil is sprinkled, sacrifices are made, incense is burnt, and they read it out in the king's presence.(ruling)
(ruling)
[ii 33] The word of Ištar of Arbela to Esarhaddon, king of Assyria:
[ii 35] Come, gods, my fathers and brothers, [enter] into the cove[nant ......]
((Break))
[iii 2] [She placed] a slice of ... on the [ter]race and gave them water from a cooler to drink; she filled a flagon of one seah with water from a cooler and gave it to them with the words:
[iii 7] "In your hearts you say, 'Ištar is slight,' and you will go to your cities and districts, eat (your) bread and forget this covenant.
[iii 12] "(But when) you drink from this water, you will remember me and keep this covenant which I have made on behalf of Esarhaddon."
(ruling)
[iii 16] The word of Ištar of Arbela to Esarhaddon, king of Assyria:
[iii 18] As if I did not do or give you anything!
[iii 20] Did I not bend the four doorjambs of Assyria, and did I not give them to you? Did I not vanquish your enemy? Did I not collect your haters and foes [like but]terflies?[iii 25][As for yo]u, what have you given to me? [iii 26][There is no fo]od for my banquet, as if there were no temple; I [am depri]ved of my food, I am d[ep]rived of my cup! I am waiting for them, I have cast my eye upon them.[iii 32] Verily, establish a seah of bowl food and a one-seah flagon of sweet beer! Let me take and put in my mouth vegetables and soup, let me fill the cup and drink from it, let me restore my charms!
((iv 1) (Break))[iv 3]let me lift [......] [iv 4][let m]e go [......] [iv 5]I went up [......] [iv 6]and arranged [a fea]st [...]. [iv 7][When] I was [there, they said: "We know] that you are Ištar [of A]rbela."[iv 10] I set out [for] Assyria to see yo[ur success], to tread the mountains [with my feet], [and to spea]k about Esarhaddon.
[iv 14] [No]w rejoice, Esarhaddon! [I have be]nt [the four doorjamb]s of Assyria and given them to you; I have vanquished yo[ur enemy. The mood of the people] who stand with you has been turned upside down.
[iv 20] [From thi]s you shall see [that] I am [Ištar of] Arbela.
[iv 22] [As soon as the traitors] have been dragged forth, ['the ones at the right and] left side' shall stand there to bear [the punishment].
[iv 25] (As for) those cou]rtiers and palace [personnel who] rebelled [against] you, [I have sur]rounded them and impaled them by their teeth.
(ruling)
